temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits that he has been keeping something from Christian and that he is in some kind of trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian suspects that Jonathan is hiding something important from him, which makes him anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Christian's suspicion is confirmed: Jonathan was hiding something and is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan has been hiding something important and is in trouble, though Christian does not yet know the details.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To uncover the full truth about what Jonathan is hiding and what trouble he is in.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says his situation is complicated, does not want to drag Christian into it, but eventually admits he could use support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is hiding something important and is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Christian learns that Jonathan's trouble is complicated and that Jonathan is willing to accept his help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in serious, complicated trouble and needs Christian's support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help and support Jonathan, provide resources, and face the situation together.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot say for sure whether the trouble is illegal, admits he may have gotten involved with the wrong people, but claims he did not do anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in complicated trouble and may be involved with criminal activity.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Christian's suspicion becomes more specific: Jonathan may be entangled with the wrong people, though Jonathan denies doing anything illegal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan may be involved with dangerous or criminal people, but he claims to be innocent of any illegal act.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate discreetly without alarming Jonathan and ensure Jonathan's safety.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed by someone who is trying to set him up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan may be involved with the wrong people, but he claims he has not done anything illegal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Christian shifts from suspecting possible criminal involvement to believing Jonathan is innocent and being framed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is being framed by someone, and Christian has leads but does not yet know who the culprit is.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear Jonathan's name by gathering evidence that proves his innocence.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian tells Jonathan that he has found out who is behind the frame-up: someone both of them know and trust.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed, and the real culprit is still unknown, though Christian has leads.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Christian identifies the real culprit as someone close to both him and Jonathan, deepening his sense of betrayal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The real culprit is a trusted mutual acquaintance who has betrayed them; Jonathan is innocent and framed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice.
